newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel mulls alternatives for units.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel mulls alternatives for units.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said it continues to consider various alternatives for its underperforming business units, including Bethlehem Structural Products, BethForge and Centec.

These alternatives include continuing to operate the business units, shutting down the business units and shutting down the units while continuing efforts to sell them. No decision has been made about any of these alternatives, the company said.

It said it has retained the services of a financial advisor and is working with representatives of the United Steelworkers of America to determine whether these business units could be sold to qualified buyers.
The company has previously stated that all of its businesses must achieve satisfactory performance or the company will exit them by either sale or shutdown, as appropriate.
